execution_validation_reason: No common GROMACS executable resolved on the maintainer Darwin arm64 host.

build-pinned-source-cmake.title: Build GROMACS 2026.3 from the official source archive
required_inputs: gromacs-2026.3 official source with recorded checksum
local regressiontests-2026.3 when regression tests are required
build-pinned-source-cmake.restart_checkpoint: Reconfigure from a fresh build tree after changing compiler, MPI, GPU, SIMD, FFT, or precision options.
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero configure/build/test/install exit blocks.
A successful install is environment evidence only.
Capture gmx mdrun -version or gmx --version after activation.
scientific_checks: none; build success proves no force field or simulation result

inspect-binary.title: Capture exact GROMACS executable and command surface
required_inputs: exact executable selected by the user
exit_and_log_semantics: Every probe must exit zero.
The parsed version must be exactly 2026.3.
Do not expose private installation paths in a shared manifest.
scientific_checks: none; command availability is not a model or result validation

prepare-biomolecular-system.title: Create topology, box, solvent, and ions with explicit model choices
prepare-biomolecular-system.restart_checkpoint: System preparation is regenerated into a new tree after any chemistry, force-field, solvent, ion, box, or seed change.
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit blocks.
grompp warnings must be resolved without -maxwarn.
Interactive selections must be recorded and checked against the exact generated index.

preprocess-new-segment.title: Preprocess one new run segment without warning suppression
preprocess-new-segment.restart_checkpoint: This is a new segment; checkpoint continuation uses the separate -t recipe.
exit_and_log_semantics: Require exit zero and an actually created nonempty run.tpr.
Any warning is reviewed; -maxwarn is forbidden as acceptance evidence.
Hash run.tpr, processed.top, mdout.mdp, and the complete input closure.
failure_modes: generated TPR not bound to transcript
scientific_checks: inspect total charge and atom counts

preprocess-checkpoint-continuation.title: Create a continuation TPR using the exact checkpoint state
required_inputs: parent run ID, TPR and output hashes
unchanged topology/model unless a documented non-exact restart is intended
preprocess-checkpoint-continuation.restart_checkpoint: Bind parent.cpt plus parent run/input/output identities; do not regenerate velocities.
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit or warning blocks.
A generated TPR does not prove output append compatibility.
Changing integrator/ensemble/model turns this into a new protocol segment and must be labeled honestly.
scientific_checks: known 2026.3 checkpoint issues for the selected algorithm

energy-minimization.title: Preprocess and run energy minimization
required_inputs: em.mdp with project-owned minimizer and tolerances
energy-minimization.restart_checkpoint: Minimization output is a new structural state, not an MD checkpoint lineage.
exit_and_log_semantics: Both commands must exit zero.
Require an unsuppressed grompp record and a terminal mdrun marker.
The minimizer stop reason must meet the predeclared rule; maximum-step termination is not automatically acceptance.
scientific_checks: relevant basin rather than only numerical stop

nvt-equilibration.title: Preprocess and run a declared NVT equilibration
required_inputs: nvt.mdp with explicit integrator, dt, steps, thermostat groups, tau_t, ref_t, seed and outputs
nvt-equilibration.restart_checkpoint: nvt.cpt is the parent state for continuation; periodic checkpoint interval is minutes, not steps.
exit_and_log_semantics: Both commands must exit zero and output files must match planned final step.
Any fatal, LINCS/SETTLE, non-finite, or constraint warning blocks.
Wall-time stop with a valid checkpoint is incomplete, not failed completion.
failure_modes: apparent equilibrium from too few relaxation times

npt-equilibration.title: Preprocess and run a declared NPT equilibration
npt-equilibration.restart_checkpoint: npt.cpt carries positions, velocities and extended coupling state; bind it to nvt ancestry and exact model inputs.
exit_and_log_semantics: Both commands must exit zero with one complete segment.
Any fatal/constraint/non-finite marker blocks.
Berendsen pressure coupling cannot support a production NPT distribution claim.

production-md.title: Preprocess and run one immutable production segment
production-md.restart_checkpoint: production.cpt plus hashes of TPR and every prior append target define the restart lineage.
exit_and_log_semantics: grompp and mdrun must exit zero for completed acceptance.
Require one version banner, final planned step, terminal marker, and no adverse marker.
If stopped by -maxh with a valid checkpoint, mark technically restartable but not complete.
Zero exit never establishes equilibrium or sufficient sampling.

continue-from-checkpoint.title: Continue an existing deffnm output set from checkpoint
required_inputs: checkpoint SHA-256 and parent run ID
all append-target files with checkpoint-matching checksums
confirmed absence of a live writer
continue-from-checkpoint.restart_checkpoint: mdrun checks prior output checksums from the checkpoint before append; otherwise it must fail without modifying files. Use -noappend for explicit part files.
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit blocks and append targets must remain unmodified on checksum mismatch.
A zero exit with final step short of plan is incomplete.
Capture segment start/end and verify exactly one logical timeline after append or part concatenation.
scientific_checks: bitwise exactness limitations across hardware/parallel layout
statistical equivalence when exactness is unavailable

extend-run-input.title: Extend an immutable TPR by an explicit additional duration
extend-run-input.restart_checkpoint: Continue production-extended.tpr with the exact production.cpt and matching outputs; do not overwrite the parent TPR.
exit_and_log_semantics: Require zero exit and a new nonempty TPR.
Hash both parent and extended TPR.
Changing physical MDP settings requires grompp and a new protocol segment, not convert-tpr.
failure_modes: physical settings changed without new plan
scientific_checks: additional sampling need is based on predeclared uncertainty/ESS, not desired result

check-native-artifacts.title: Inspect native trajectory, energy, structure, and index integrity
required_inputs: exact artifacts from one run lineage
check-native-artifacts.restart_checkpoint: not a restart action; use it before any append, concatenation, or analysis handoff
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit or reported corruption/inconsistency blocks.
A clean container/file check does not prove correct physics or complete sampling.
scientific_checks: frame cadence and atom count against plan

inspect-run-input-and-checkpoint.title: Render TPR methods and inspect checkpoint metadata
required_inputs: TPR and optional checkpoint from one exact lineage
inspect-run-input-and-checkpoint.restart_checkpoint: Checkpoint inspection is read-only; it does not authorize continuation.
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit blocks.
Capture output hashes rather than trusting a filename.
Provider-rendered text supplements but does not replace original input/provenance records.
failure_modes: private path leakage in captured text
scientific_checks: bind checkpoint step/time to parent output
record unsupported or omitted method details

extract-energy-series.title: Extract predeclared energy terms to XVG
unresolved_parameters: energy term names from the exact EDR
required_inputs: predeclared term names and analysis interval
extract-energy-series.restart_checkpoint: not-applicable; analyze concatenated logical time only after segment integrity is proven
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit or missing selected term blocks.
Record the exact interactive selections.
Native block statistics are supporting evidence; apply the project uncertainty protocol separately.

trajectory-pbc-view.title: Create a visualization-only molecularly whole centered trajectory
trajectory-pbc-view.restart_checkpoint: not-applicable; never feed a visualization transform back into dynamics without a new audited preparation step
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit blocks.
Preserve the raw trajectory immutable.
Hash the transform command and group selections.
failure_modes: molecules split because topology is absent/wrong
scientific_checks: PBC treatment must match the observable
diffusion/MSD requires continuous/unwrapped displacement semantics rather than a display transform

rmsd-analysis.title: Compute RMSD with explicit fit and measurement groups
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit or empty output blocks.
Record both interactive group choices and reference identity.
scientific_checks: RMSD alone does not prove equilibrium or native-state stability

rdf-analysis.title: Compute a radial distribution function with selection expressions
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit or empty selection blocks.
Selection expressions are evidence and must be retained verbatim.

msd-analysis.title: Estimate diffusion from mean-squared displacement
required_inputs: accepted trajectory with suitable PBC continuity
msd-analysis.restart_checkpoint: Segment boundaries and unwrapping lineage must be explicit; do not reset displacement origins invisibly.
exit_and_log_semantics: Any nonzero exit or invalid fit blocks.
Retain fit interval and group selection.
A printed diffusion coefficient is not accepted without regime and uncertainty evidence.
